verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਾ: ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: soraThaa: jagamag jot saroop param jot mil jot meh ||

en.bdb: Sorath: The light eternal of Guru Nanak Dev melded into the light of Guru Angad Dev who acquired effulgence like the former.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਦਭੁਤ ਅਤਿਹਿ ਅਨੂਪ ਪਰਮ ਤਤ ਤਤਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ॥
verses.translit_en: adhabhut ateh anoop param tat tateh milio ||

en.bdb: With the light of Guru Nanak merging with that of Guru Angad Dev Ji, the latter became wondrous in form and beyond words of praise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੋਹਰਾ: ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhoharaa: param jot mil jot meh jagamag jot saroop ||

en.bdb: Dohra: Light supreme (Guru Nanak Dev Ji) merged in Guru Angad Dev's light who himself became light divine.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਤਤ ਤਤਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਅਦਭੁਤ ਅਤਿਹਿ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
verses.translit_en: param tat tateh milio adhabhut ateh anoop ||

en.bdb: Truth of Guru Nanak merged with the essence of Guru Angad transforming him into astonishing form.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛੰਦ: ਅਦਭੁਤ ਅਤਿਹਿ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਪਾਰਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਰਸ ॥
verses.translit_en: chha(n)dh: adhabhut ateh anoop roop paaras kai paaras ||

en.bdb: Channt: Guru Angad coming in contact with Guru Nanak the philosopher-stone, became a philosopher-stone himself. His form too became wondrous.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗ ਉਧਾਰਸ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur a(n)gadh mil a(n)g sa(n)g mil sa(n)g udhaaras ||

en.bdb: Becoming inseparable from Guru Nanak, Lehna Ji became Guru Angad and then whosoever came in touch with him (Guru Angad) was liberated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਗਤਿ ਓਤ ਪੋਤ ਮਹਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: akal kalaa bharapoor sootr gat ot pot meh ||

en.bdb: Guru Angad Ji integrated himself like warp and weft with Guru Nanak, the possessor of Divine power of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit_en: jagamag jot saroop jot mil jot jot meh ||3||

en.bdb: Light merged with light so much that whosoever came in contact with light embodiment (Guru Angad) , became resplendent too. (3)
